body: 9:16米白纸张手绘中文知识卡，主题泡茶。顶部红黑毛笔中文标题准确写“泡茶三步”。下方三个留白充足的区块，依次准确写“温杯”“投茶”“注水”；分别配空杯、茶叶和茶壶倒水的简洁手绘图标。只有这四组文字，不添加小字说明。温润纸纹，图文清楚分离。

en.title: Hand-drawn tea instruction card
en.description: The title 泡茶三步 and the ordered steps 温杯、投茶、注水 are correct, with separate cup, leaf and pouring illustrations on warm paper.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

The title 泡茶三步 and the ordered steps 温杯、投茶、注水 are correct, with separate cup, leaf and pouring illustrations on warm paper.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 26. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md#case-38-hand-drawn-infographic-card). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
